text_block_list.name: Train Announcement
text_block_list.text: We are approaching the last stop… Please ensure you take all your personal belongings as you exit the train.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Crap… I'm way past where I was supposed to get off!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Even if I get off and start going back the other way, I won't make it back to the academy by curfew.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: I could ask my manager… no, they'll be busy with that meeting right now. Sigh…
Gold City later gets scolded for returning after curfew.
